narrative.overview:
A pool of warm amber light on a dark desk. Everything outside the light recedes; the card in front of you is all that matters. The interface is the desk lamp: it illuminates the content and gets out of the way.

The system is restrained by conviction. Amber (#F59E0B) is the only saturated color, and it earns its place on primary actions and active states. Everything else is tinted neutral: zinc surfaces, graphite borders, dim text.

Typography carries the personality. DM Serif Display gives headings warmth and gravitas without shouting. DM Sans is the workhorse, clean at body size and legible at label size.
keyCharacteristics: Dark base (#0E0E10) with warm amber accent; no other saturated colors at rest
Tonal layering for depth (base → surface → elevated), no drop shadows
0.5px borders for separation, never heavy outlines
Spring-based motion: physical, not decorative; max 500ms
Mobile-first, one-thumb operation: 44px minimum touch targets

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only warm, saturated color on any screen at rest. The four semantic rating colors appear only during active rating interaction and disappear immediately after.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: All neutrals carry a faint warm tint. Pure gray (#808080) is prohibited.

rules.name: The Serif-Once Rule
rules.body: DM Serif Display appears on at most one element per screen. Overuse collapses the hierarchy.

rules.name: The 65ch Rule
rules.body: Body text line length never exceeds 75 characters. Long lines destroy comprehension on mobile.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Elevation is expressed through tonal value, not through shadow or blur.

dos: Use amber (#F59E0B) as the sole accent color for all interactive highlights, focus rings, and primary buttons.
Express elevation through tonal layering (base → surface → elevated), never through drop shadows.
Use DM Serif Display for display headings, maximum once per screen.
Cap body text at 75 characters per line for comfortable reading on mobile.
Use spring animations (stiffness: 400, damping: 30) for interactive feedback.
Maintain 44px minimum touch targets for all interactive elements.
Use 0.5px borders for subtle separation between surfaces.
donts: Don't use glassmorphism, frosted glass effects, or decorative blur overlays.
Don't use neon accents, glowing text, or bright borders.
Don't use heavy drop shadows for elevation.
Don't use default Tailwind gray scales. All neutrals are custom-tinted zinc values.
Don't use Inter, Roboto, Arial, or Space Grotesk.
Don't create cluttered dashboard layouts or widget overload.
Don't build hover-only interactions. Mobile-first means touch is primary.
Don't use color as the sole indicator of state.
Don't animate CSS layout properties. Use transform and opacity only.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing curves.
